description: Na₂B₂Se₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.36 Å. B is bonded to four Se atoms to form corner-sharing BSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-Se bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.06 Å. There are four inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent B atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.40 Å. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Se atom. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom.
